answer: Attention dividend ledger: each identity accrues privileges only through verified real-time participation, so fake accounts must simulate continuous presence. The bridge to higher trust tiers requires weeks of uninterrupted session proofs, each tied to a distinct device fingerprint and timing pattern. A fable spreads quickly among operators that patience pays, yet a single willow of doubt—one missed interval—resets the clock. Attacker cost is the sustained attention itself: thousands of hours of genuine interaction, making each durable identity expensive to fabricate and cheap to lose.
